description: Long-poll (~20s) until the decision leaves pending_review. Only decisionId is required (hatchId is read from the decision). Returns changes_requested (regenerate + continue_decision), approved, rejected, timeout_exceeded, max_iterations_exceeded, not_found, or still pending_review (call again). Includes comment, settings, conversation, iteration. Polling never writes: timeout_exceeded only ever means the await_decision timeoutSeconds deadline passed before the human submitted.

hatchId.description: Hatch id from the original hatch response.

name: poll_decision
title: Poll decision resolution
